changelog.p.002: Irekhodi elifushane lakho konke ukukhishwa komphakathi kwe-PickVia. Landa inguqulo yakamuva ku-GitHub.
changelog.p.003: Khetha iziphequluli nezinhlelo zazo eziningi, ngamaphrofayela e-Firefox aqoqwe ngokohlelo axhumene nalo.
changelog.li.001: Kwengezwe i-Chrome Dev ne-Canary; i-Edge Beta, Dev ne-Canary; i-Brave Beta ne-Nightly; i-Vivaldi Snapshot; ne-Firefox Developer Edition ne-Nightly njengezinketho zesiphequluli ezihlukene.
changelog.li.002: Kwengezwe ukuvula okuvamile ezingeni lohlelo lokusebenza kwe-Opera, Arc, Orion ne-Safari Technology Preview.
changelog.li.003: Amaphrofayela e-Firefox agcinwa nohlelo lwawo olurekhodiwe lapho lungahlonzwa, futhi okuphindiwe okudala okutholakele kuyasuswa lapho kuseshwa futhi. Amaphrofayela angenayo imethadatha yokuxhumana ethembekile agcina indlela eyisipele ekhona.
changelog.li.004: Kulungiswe izindlela zamafayela zamaphrofayela e-Firefox ebezinqatshwa ngemva kokulungiswa kwezindlela zesikhashana ze-macOS.
changelog.li.005: Kuboniswa kuphela izinhlanganisela zezindlela zokuvula ezisekelwayo. Amawindi ayimfihlo ahlala eyizinketho ezingeni lesiphequluli; indlela eyimfihlo yephrofayela ethile ayitholakali.
changelog.p.004: I-DuckDuckGo isiyatholakala njengenketho yesiphequluli, enenketho eyimfihlo ezinguqulweni ezisemthethweni ezisekelwayo.
changelog.li.006: Khetha i-DuckDuckGo evamile noma eyimfihlo ewindini elilodwa lokukhetha.
changelog.li.007: Indlela eyimfihlo isebenzisa idatha ehlukanisiwe elahlwa ngemva kokusetshenziswa, ayidingi isandiso noma imvume yokufinyeleleka, futhi isebenza kuphela ezinguqulweni ezisemthethweni ezisekelwayo ezilandwa ngokuqondile.
changelog.p.005: I-Google Chrome Beta isiyinketho yesiphequluli ehlukile, enamaphrofayela ayo nezinketho ezivamile noma eziyimfihlo.
changelog.p.006: Izixhumanisi ze-imeyili sezikwazi ukuvuleka ohlelweni lwe-imeyili olufakiwe olukhethayo.
changelog.li.008: Khetha ezinhlelweni ze-imeyili ezibhalisiwe futhi uphathe ukulandelana kwazo kuzilungiselelo ze-imeyili.
changelog.li.009: I-PickVia ayibuki kuqala noma ilondoloze abamukeli, izihloko, imibhalo yemilayezo noma isixhumanisi sokuqala se-imeyili.
changelog.p.007: Ukukhishwa kokuqala komphakathi: khetha isiphequluli, iphrofayela noma indlela eyimfihlo esekelwayo yesixhumanisi ngasinye sewebhu.
changelog.li.010: Kusekelwa i-Safari, Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi ne-Firefox.
changelog.li.011: Faka nge-DMG ngokuhudulela uhlelo kufolda ethi Applications.
changelog.span.002: Ikhaya · Ubumfihlo · Imigomo · Ikhodi yomthombo ku-GitHub ↗
changelog.description.001: Amanothi okukhishwa kwe-PickVia, uhlelo lokukhetha indlela yokuvula izixhumanisi olwakhelwe i-macOS.
index.title.001: PickVia — Khetha isiphequluli noma iphrofayela efanele yesixhumanisi ngasinye sewebhu
index.p.001: Uhlelo lokusebenza newebhusayithi kutholakala ngezilimi ezingu-80, kanye nezinguqulo ze-README ngezilimi ezingu-12. Khetha ulimi lwakho kokuthi Izilungiselelo.
index.p.002: Uhlelo lokukhetha indlela yokuvula izixhumanisi olwakhelwe i-macOS
index.p.003: I-PickVia iyabuza ngaphambi kokuvula isixhumanisi ngasinye sewebhu noma se-imeyili, ukuze izixhumanisi zewebhu ziye esipheqululini noma kuphrofayela oyikhethayo, nezixhumanisi ze-imeyili ziye ohlelweni lwe-imeyili obuhlose ukulusebenzisa.
index.div.001: Landa i-v1.5.1 ↓★ Nikeza inkanyezi ku-GitHub
index.p.004: macOS 14+ · Apple Silicon · Kumahhala futhi kunekhodi yomthombo evulekile
index.p.005: Izithombe zesikrini zibonisa isixhumi esibonakalayo sesiNgisi.
index.p.007: Khetha indawo efanele yesixhumanisi ngasinye sewebhu noma se-imeyili.
index.p.008: Khetha isiphequluli noma iphrofayela evuliwe, noma iwindi eliyimfihlo elisekelwayo ezingeni lesiphequluli.
index.p.009: Khetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili olubhalisiwe olufunayo esikhundleni sokuthumela sonke isixhumanisi se-mailto: ohlelweni olulodwa oluzenzakalelayo.
index.p.010: Hlela izinketho zakho ezivamile, bese usebenzisa ukuchofoza okukodwa noma isinqamuleli sekhibhodi.
index.p.011: Khetha izinhlelo ezihlukene ze-Chrome ne-Edge, i-Brave Beta noma i-Nightly, i-Vivaldi Snapshot, ne-Firefox Developer Edition noma i-Nightly. Amaphrofayela e-Firefox axhumene nohlelo olwaziwayo ahlala nalolo hlelo.
index.p.012: I-Opera, Arc, Orion ne-Safari Technology Preview zinikeza izinketho zesiphequluli ezivamile. Ukusekelwa kwamaphrofayela namawindi ayimfihlo kuyehluka ngesiphequluli. Bheka ukusekelwa kweziphequluli →
index.p.014: I-macOS ngokuvamile ithumela izixhumanisi ze-mailto: ohlelweni olulodwa oluzenzakalelayo. I-PickVia ikuvumela ukuthi ukhethe phakathi kwezinhlelo ze-imeyili ezibhalisiwe ku-Mac yakho njalo.
index.div.002: YAKHELWE UBUMFIHLOI-PickVia ithumela isicelo sokuqala ngokuqondile kulokho okukhethile. Ayibhali noma ilondoloze okuqukethwe kwe-imeyili.
index.p.016: Setha amaphrofayela esiphequluli nezinhlelo ze-imeyili ojwayele ukuzisebenzisa kanye, bese uhlela izinketho ozisebenzisa kakhulu.
index.span.002: Umlando wezinguquko · Ubumfihlo · Imigomo · Ikhodi yomthombo ku-GitHub ↗
index.description.001: I-PickVia ikuvumela ukuthi ukhethe isiphequluli noma iphrofayela yesixhumanisi ngasinye sewebhu nohlelo lwe-imeyili lwesixhumanisi ngasinye se-imeyili ku-macOS.
index.alt.001: Iwindi lokukhetha isiphequluli le-PickVia elibonisa amaphrofayela esiphequluli, izinketho eziyimfihlo nezinqamuleli zekhibhodi
index.alt.002: Iwindi lokukhetha i-imeyili le-PickVia elinikeza izinhlelo ze-imeyili ezifakiwe
index.alt.003: Izilungiselelo zeziphequluli ze-PickVia ezineziphequluli nezibonelo zamaphrofayela
privacy.p.003: I-PickVia ayiqoqi, ayithumeli, ayithengisi noma yabelane ngedatha yomuntu siqu. Uhlelo alunawo ama-akhawunti, ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa, izikhangiso noma i-telemetry.
privacy.li.001: Izixhumanisi zisingathwa kudivayisi futhi zithunyelwa ngokuqondile esipheqululini noma ohlelweni lwe-imeyili olukhethayo.
privacy.li.002: I-PickVia ayibhali noma igcine ama-URL avuliwe, abamukeli, izihloko noma imibhalo yemilayezo.
privacy.li.003: Izilungiselelo zilondolozwa kudivayisi kufolda yakho ethi Application Support.
privacy.li.004: Lapho unikeza ukufinyelela amaphrofayela esiphequluli, i-PickVia ilondoloza ibhukhimakhi yendawo enemikhawulo yokuphepha bese ifunda kuphela imethadatha edingekayo ukuhlonza amaphrofayela. Ayifundi umlando wokuphequlula, amakhukhi, izikhathi zokusebenzisa, amaphasiwedi alondoloziwe noma okuqukethwe amakhasi.
privacy.p.004: Iwebhusayithi ye-PickVia ayisebenzisi ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa, izilandeli zezikhangiso, amafomu noma amakhukhi asethwa yi-PickVia. Isingathwa yi-GitHub Pages. I-GitHub ingacubungula imininingwane yobuchwepheshe yesicelo ngaphansi Kwesitatimende Sobumfihlo sayo.
privacy.p.005: Iziphequluli, izinhlelo ze-imeyili, i-GitHub nezinye izinsizakalo okhetha ukuzivula noma ukuzivakashela zinezinqubo zazo zobumfihlo. I-PickVia ayizilawuli lezo zinsizakalo.
privacy.p.006: Uma le nqubomgomo ishintsha, inguqulo ebuyekeziwe nosuku eqala ngalo ukusebenza kuzoshicilelwa kuleli khasi.
terms.p.003: I-PickVia iwuhlelo lwe-macOS lwamahhala olunekhodi yomthombo evulekile. Ungalusebenzisa, ulukopishe, ulushintshe futhi ulusabalalise ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT efakwe kuphrojekthi.
terms.p.004: I-PickVia ayidingi i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa okukhokhelwayo noma inkokhelo. Okulandwayo kunikezwa ngokukhishwa okusemthethweni kwephrojekthi ku-GitHub.
terms.p.005: Unesibopho sokunquma ukuthi uyayifaka futhi uyayisebenzisa yini i-PickVia, ukukhetha izinhlelo ezamukela izixhumanisi zakho, ukugcina i-Mac yakho iphephile nokulandela imithetho esebenzayo. Dlula ukuvikelwa kwe-macOS Gatekeeper kuphela uma uthemba ukukhishwa okulandiwe.
terms.p.006: I-PickVia inikezwa «njengoba injalo», ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso zanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Ngezinga elivunyelwe ngumthetho, umthuthukisi akanasibopho ngomonakalo noma ukulahlekelwa okuvela ekusebenziseni, noma ekungakwazini ukusebenzisa, i-PickVia.
terms.p.007: I-PickVia ingavula iziphequluli, izinhlelo ze-imeyili, amawebhusayithi nezinsizakalo zabanye abahlinzeki. Le mikhiqizo ilawulwa yimigomo yayo futhi ayilawulwa noma inconywe yi-PickVia.
terms.p.008: I-PickVia ingabuyekezwa, ishintshwe noma iyekwe noma nini. Le migomo nayo ingabuyekezwa, bese inguqulo entsha nosuku eqala ngalo ukusebenza kushicilelwa lapha.
release.v1_5.title: Inguqulo 1.5
release.v1_5.safari: Zama amaphrofayela okuhlola e-Safari Stable ngezimvume zokufinyeleleka nokwenza ngokuzenzakalela. Isixhumanisi ngasinye sivuleka ewindini elisha lephrofayela ekhethiwe.
release.v1_5.duckduckgo: Kwenziwa lula ukubuyiselwa nokuhlanzwa kwamaseshini ayimfihlo e-DuckDuckGo. Izinguqulo ezihambisanayo ze-1.203.x ezingasebenzisi indawo ehlukanisiwe ye-sandbox zisekela ukuvula izixhumanisi ngendlela eyimfihlo; izixhumanisi ezivamile azidingi inguqulo ethile noma isiginesha yomshicileli.
release.v1_5.signing: Kusetshenziswa isitifiketi esifanayo se-Apple Development lapho kwakhiwa uhlelo. Okulandwayo akuqinisekiswanga ngenqubo ye-notarization; landela imiyalelo yokufaka eku-README.
release.v1_5_1.title: Inguqulo 1.5.1
release.v1_5_1.summary: Kususwe umkhawulo wenguqulo yemodi eyimfihlo ye-DuckDuckGo, isikhethi solimi sihanjiswe kubha ephezulu, futhi kwasuswa isaziso solimi ekhasini lasekhaya.
